summary.content:
Today's selection covers 77 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 55 on Artificial Intelligence and 14 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI Ignored Employees’ Warnings About Safely Testing A.I. Models
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Vietnamese man charged in $16 million 'pig butchering' crypto scam
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BBC Technology, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 66 articles published in the last 24 hours
